G2805.definition: (κλαίω),  ; crying, weeping, Act.20:37; κ. καὶ ὀδυρμός, Mat.2:18 (LXX); ὁ κ. καὶ ὁ βρυγμός, Mat.8:12 13:42, 50 22:13 24:51 25:30, Luk.13:28.†; (AS)

G2889.definition: 1. order (Hom., Plat., al.). ; 2. ornament, adornment, esp. of women (Hom., al.): 1Pe.3:3. ; 3. Later, the world or universe, as an ordered system (Plat., al.): Act.17:24, Rom.4:13, 1Co.3:22, Php.2:15, Heb.4:3, al. ; 4. In late writers only, the world, i.e. the earth (= ἡ οἰκουμένη, cf. Mat.4:8 with Luk.4:5): Mat.4:8, Mrk.16:, Col.2:20, 1Ti.6:7, al.; hence by meton., ; (a) of the human inhabitants of the world…

G2816.definition: (κληρονόμος)  ; 1. to receive by lot. ; 2. to inherit (in cl., usually with genitive of thing(s)): absol., Gal.4:30 (LXX); in general, to possess oneself of, receive as one's own, obtain (as Deu.4:5, al., cf. Psa.25:3, Isa.61:7): with accusative of thing(s) (as generally in late Gk., see M, Pr., 65), of the Messianic Kingdom (cf. Psa.37:11, Sir.4:13 37:26, and see Dalman, Words, 125 ff.) and its bless­ings and…

G2835.definition: κοδράντης, -ου, ὁ (Lat. quadrans, the fourth part of an as), ; a quadrans (AV, farthing): Mat.5:26, Mrk.12:42.†; (AS)

G2808.definition: to shut: θύραν, Mat.6:6; τ. ἄβυσσον, Rev.20:3; pass., θύρα, Mat.25:10, Luk.11:7 (pl.), Jhn.20:19, 26, Act.21:30; δεσμωτήριον, Act.5:23; πυλῶνες, Rev.21:25. Metaphorical, τ. οὐρανόν, Luk.4:25, Rom.11:6; τ. σπλάγχνα, 1Jn.3:17; τ. βασιλείαν, Mat.23:14; id. absol., Rev.3:7; τ. θύραν, Rev.3:8. (cf. ἀπο-, ἐκ-, κατα-, συν-κλείω.) †; (AS)

G2812.definition: a thief: Mat.6:19-20 24:43, Luk.12:33, 39, Jhn.10:1, 10 12:6, 1Co.6:10, 1Pe.4:15. Fig., ὡς κ. ἐν νυκτί, 1Th.5:2 5:4 (κλέπτας, WH, txt., R, mg.; see Lft., Notes, 73; but cf. also M, Th., l.with), 2Pe.3:10, Rev.3:3 16:15. Metaphorical, of false teachers, Jhn.10:8.†; SYN.: λῃστής, a robber, a brigand who plunders, openly, with violence; κ. is a thief who steals in secret, by fraud and cunning (Tr., Syn., § xliv) (AS)

G2813.definition: to steal: absol., Mat.6:19-20 19:18, Mrk.10:19, Luk.18:20, Jhn.10:10, Rom.2:21 13:9, Eph.4:28; with accusative, Mat.27:64 28:13.†; (AS)

G2872.definition: (κόπος),  ; 1. (as in cl.) to grow weary: Mat.11:28, Jhn.4:6, Rev.2:3 (cf. Isa.40:31). ; 2. Hence, in LXX and NT, to work with effort, to toil: absol., Mat.6:23, Luk.5:5 12:27, Jhn.4:38, Act.20:35, 1Co.4:12, Eph.4:28, 2Ti.2:5; with accusative of thing(s), Jhn.4:38; frequently in Paul. Epp., of ministerial labour: 1Co.15:10 16:16; before ἐν, Rom.16:12, 1Th.5:12 (see M, Th., in l), 1Ti.5:17; εἰς, Rom.16:6, Gal.4:11…

G2823.definition: (Att.., κρίβ-, but κλ- in Ion., Hdt., ii, 92),  ; 1. in cl., a clibanus, cribanus, an earthen vessel for baking bread. ; 2. In LXX and NT, a furnace (cf. MM, Exp., xv), an oven: Mat.6:30, Luk.12:28.†; (AS)

G2827.definition: 1. to make to bend, to bow: τ. κεφαλήν (of one dying), Jhn.19:30; τ. πρόσωτον (of terrified persons), Luk.24:5. ; 2. to make to lean, to rest: τ. κεφαλήν (in sleep), Mat.8:20, Luk.9:58. ; 3. As in Hom., of soldiers, to turn (to flight), παρεμβολάς, Heb.11:34. ; 4. In late Gk. (as mid, in cl.), to decline: intrans., ἡ ἡμέρα, Luk.9:12 24:29.†; (AS)

G2896.definition: in cl. chiefly poët., ; 1. prop. onomatop., of the raven, to croak, hence generally, of inartic. cries, to scream, cry out (Æsch., al.): Mrk.5:5 9:26 15:39 (Rec., R, mg.), Luk.9:39, al.; of crying for vengeance (cf. Gen.4:10), Jas.5:4. ; 2. to cry, call out with a loud voice: with accusative of thing(s), Act.19:32; before orat. dir., Mrk.10:48, Luk.18:39, al.; (ἐν) φωνῇ μεγάλῃ, Mrk.5:7, Rev.14:15, al.; λέγων…
renderings: called out in a loud voice

G2899.definition: 1. in cl., an edge, border. ; 2. In LXX (see supr.) and NT, a tassel or corner: Mat.9:20 14:36 23:5, Mrk.6:56, Luk.8:44.†; (AS)

G2877.definition: (dimin. of κόρη),  ; a colloquial word which survives in MGr. (Kennedy, Sourcs, e154), girl, maiden: Mat.9:24-25 14:11, Mrk.5:41-42 6:22, 28.†; (AS)

G2868.definition: (κόνις or κονία, dust, ὄρνυμι, to stir up),  ; in cl., dust stirred up (Exo.9:9, Isa.5:24); in NT, simply dust: Mat.10:14, Luk.9:5 10:11, Act.13:51 22:23.†; (AS)

G2875.definition: 1. to strike, smite. ; 2. to cut off: with accusative of thing(s), before ἀπό, Mat.21:8; ἐκ, Mrk.11:8. Mid., to beat one's breast with grief, to mourn, bewail: Mat.11:17 24:30; with accusative of person(s), Luk.8:52 23:27; before ἐπί, with accusative, Rev.1:7 18:9 (cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο-, ἐκ-, ἐν-, κατα-, προ-, προσ-κόπτω).†; SYN.: θρηνέω, q.v (AS)

G2836.definition: (κοῖλος, hollow),  ; 1. the belly (stomach or intestines or both): Mat.12:40 15:17, Mrk.7:19, Luk.15:16, Rom.16:18, 1Co.6:13, Php.3:19, Rev.10:9-10. ; 2. (As often in LXX) the womb: Luk.1:41-42, 44 2:21 11:27 23:29, Jhn.3:4; ἐκ κ. μητρός (cf. Psa.22:11, Job.1:21, al.), Mat.19:12, Luk.1:15, Act.3:2 14:8, Gal.1:15. ; 3. Metaphorical (as Heb. בֶּטֶן, cf. Job.15:35, Pro.20:27, Sir.19:12), of the heart: Jhn.7:38.†; (AS)

G2885.definition: (κόσμος),  ; 1. to order, arrange, prepare (in Hom. esp. of marshalling armies): Mat.25:7 (cf. Sir.50:9, al.). ; 2. to adorn, furnish: οἶκον, pass., Mat.12:44, Luk.11:25; μνημεῖα, Mat.23:29; τὸ ἱερόν, pass., Luk.21:5; θεμέλιοι, Rev.21:19; νύμφην, pass., Rev.21:2; ἐαυτάς, before ἐν, 1Ti.2:9. Metaphorical, with accusative of person(s), 1Pe.3:5; with accusative of thing(s), Tit.2:10.†; (AS)

G2806.definition: to break, break in pieces: of bread, Mat.14:19 15:36 26:26, Mrk.8:6 14:22, Luk.22:19 24:30, Act.2:46 20:7, 11 27:35, 1Co.10:16 11:24; before εἰς, with accusative of person(s), Mrk.8:19 (cf. ἐκ-, κατα-κλάω).†; (AS)

G2801.definition: (κλάω),  ; a broken piece, fragment: Mat.14:20 15:37, Mrk.6:43 8:8, 19-20, Luk.9:17, Jhn.6:12-13 †; (AS)

G2894.definition: a basket, probably of wicker-work, such as were carried by Jews for food: Mat.14:20 16:9, Mrk.6:43 8:19 9:17 13:8, Jhn.6:13 (cf. σφυρίς).†; (AS)

G2869.definition: (κόπος),  ; to grow weary; of the wind (Hdt., Jh., l.with), to abate, cease raging: Mat.14:32, Mrk.4:39 6:51.†; (AS)

G2840.definition: 1. in cl., to make common. ; 2. In LXX, l.with, and NT (as κοινός, 2), to make ceremonially unclean, to profane (= cl., βεληλόω): Mat.15:11, 18 15:20, Mrk.7:15, 18 7:20, 23, Act.21:28; pass., Heb.9:13. ; 3. to count unclean (cf. δικαιόω): Act.10:15 11:9.†; SYN.: βεβηλόω. Thayer (see word κ.) mentions that Winer Notes the accuracy whereby the Jews are said to use κ. in addressing Jews, Act.21:28, and β. when speaking…

G2807.definition: κλείς, -δός Att.. accusative, κλεῖν, later -εῖδα, pl., κλεῖδες, -ας, contr., -εῖς, ἡ,; a key. Fig., τ. βασιλείας τ. οὐρανῶν, Mat.16:19; τ. γνώσεως, Luk.11:52; of David (cf. LXX, l.with), Rev.3:7; τ. θανάτου κ. τ. ᾅδου, Rev.1:18; τ. ἀβύσσαυ, Rev.20:1; τ. φρέατος τῆς ἀ., Rev.9:1.†; (AS)

G2853.definition: (κόλλα, glue),  ; 1. to glue or cement together. ; 2. Generally, to unite, to join firmly. Pass., to cleave to, join (oneself to): with dative of person(s), Mat.19:5(LXX), Luk.10:11 15:15, Act.5:13 (but see Field, Notes, 118) Act.9:26 10:28 (see Field, l.with) Act.17:34; τ. πόρνῃ, 1Co.6:16; τ. Κυρίῳ, 1Co.6:17; with dative of thing(s), ἅρματι, Act.8:29; τ. ἀγαθῴ, Rom.12:9; of sins joining together, ἄχρι τ. οὐρανοῦ…

G2855.definition: (κόλλυβος, a small coin, a rate of exchange), ; a money-changer: Mat.21:12, Mrk.11:15, Jhn.2:15 (of. κερματιοτής).†; (AS)

G2818.definition: κληρο-νόμος, -ου, ὁ; (κλῆρος, νέμομαι, to possess)  ; 1. (as in cl.) an heir: Mat.21:38, Mrk.12:7, Luk.20:14, Gal.4:1; of those who as sons of God inherit the privileges of the Messianic Kingdom; of Christ himself, Heb.1:2; of Abraham, Rom.4:13-14; of Christians, Rom.8:17, Gal.3:29, Tit.3:7, Jas.2:5. ; 2. (As in LXX: Jg, Mi, Je, ll. with) a possessor: Heb.6:17 11:7 (Cremer, 359 f.).†; (AS)

G2817.definition: (κληρονόμος)  ; prop., an inherited property, an inheritance: Mat.21:38, Mrk.12:7, Luk.12:13 20:14; in general, a possession, inheritance: Act.7:5, Heb.11:8; of the Messianic Kingdom and its blessings, Act.20:32, Gal.3:18, Col.3:24, Eph.1:14, 18 5:5, Heb.9:15, 1Pe.1:4.†; (AS)

G2822.definition: (καλέω),  ; called, invited (as to a banquet, Æsch., 1Sa 1:41, 3Ma.5:14); in NT, always of the Divine call; (a) to some office: κ. ἀπόστολος, Rom.1:1, 1Co.1:1; (b) to salvation: Rom.8:28, 1Co.1:24, Ju 1; κ. καὶ ἐκλεκτοὶ κ. πιστοί, Rev.17:14; in gosp. (not in pl., see: καλέω) disting. fr.ἐκλεκτός, Mat.20:16 (WH, txt., R, omit), Mat.22:14; κ. Ἰησοῦ Χρ., Rom.1:6; κ. ἅγιοι, saints by calling, Rom.1:7, 1Co.1:2.†; (AS)

G2867.definition: (κονία, dust, lime),  ; to plaster or whiten over: of tombs, Mat.23:27; figuratively, of a hypocrite, Act.23:3.†; (AS)

G2844.definition: (κοινός),  ; 1. as adj., = κοινός. ; 2. As subst., ὁ, ἡ κ., ; (a) a partner, associate, companion: 2Co.8:23, Phm 17; with dative of person(s), Luk.5:10; with genitive of person(s), Heb.10:33; id. before ἐν, Mat.23:30; (b) a partaker, sharer: with genitive of thing(s), 1Co.10:18 10:20, 2Co.1:7, 1Pe.5:1, 2Pe.1:4 (see Deiss., BS, 368 n2).†; (AS)

G2856.definition: (κολοβός, docked),  ; to cut off, amputate (LXX), hence, to curtail, shorten: Mat.24:22, Mrk.13:20.†; (AS)

G2865.definition: 1. to take care of. ; 2. to carry off safe. ; 3. to carry off as booty. ; 4. to bear or carry: Luk.7:37. Mid., to bear for oneself, hence, ; (a) to receive: Heb.10:36 11:13, 39, 1Pe.1:9 5:4, 2Pe.2:13; (b) to receive back, recover (in cl. so also act.): Mat.25:27, Heb.11:19; metaphorically, of requital, 2Co.5:10, Col.3:25; παρὰ Κυρίου, Eph.6:8 (cf. ἐκ-, συν-κομίζω).†; (AS)

G2851.definition: (κολάζω),  ; correction, penalty, punishment: Mat.25:46, 1Jn.4:18.†; SYN.: τιμωρία, requital. Arist. distinguishes between κ . as that which, being disciplinary, has reference to the sufferer, and τ. as that which, being penal, has reference to the satisfaction of him who inflicts (see Thayer, see word κ., and cf. Tr., Syn., § vii). But in late Gk. especially, the distinction is not always maintained (see reff. in…

G2873.definition: (κόπτω)  ; 1. a striking, beating (in Jer.45:3 = κοπετός) ; 2. laborious toil, trouble: Jhn.4:38, 1Co.3:8 15:58, 1Th.3:5; κ. τ. ἀγάπης, 1Th.1:3; ἔργα καὶ κ., Rev.2:2; κ. καὶ μόχθος, 2Co.11:27, 1Th.2:9, 2Th.3:8; pl., ἐν κ., 2Co.6:5 10:15 11:23; ἐκ τ. κ., Rev.14:13; κόπονς (-ον) παρέχειν (in cl. more frequently π. πράγματα, πονον), with dative of person(s), Mat.26:10, Mrk.14:6, Luk.11:7 18:5, Gal.6:17.†; SYN.: μόλθος…

G2852.definition: (κόλαφος = Att.., κόνδυλοι, the knuckles, the closed fist) ; to strike with the fist, to buffet: Mat.26:67, Mrk.14:65, 2Co.12:7; pass., 1Co.4:11, 1Pe.2:20.†; (AS)

G2878.definition: κορβάν (Rec., T, -βᾶν), indecl. (Heb. קׇרְבָּן), ; an offering, a gift offered to God: Mrk.7:11 (cf. κορβανᾶς).†; (AS)

G2847.definition: (κόκκος, as used of the "berry" of the ilex coccifera, see DB, iv, 416),  ; scarlet: Mat.27:28, Heb.9:19, Rev.17:3; neut., without substantive, of clothing, Rev.17:4 18:12, 16,†; (AS)

G2898.definition: (κάρα, the head),  ; a skull: Mat.27:33, Mrk.15:22, Luk.23:33, Jhn.19:17.†; (AS)

G2819.definition: a lot; (a) that which is cast or drawn: Mat.27:35, Mrk.15:24, Luk.23:34, Jhn.19:24" (LXX), Act.1:26; (b) that which is obtained by casting: Act.1:17 8:21; of a part in the Kingdom of God (cf. Wis 55), Act.26:18, Col.1:12; pl. of the "cure" of a presbyter, 1Pe.5:3 (see ICC, in l).†; (AS)

G2837.definition: to lull to sleep, put to sleep. Mid and pass., to fall asleep (M, Pr., 162; M, Th., 1, 4, 13): Mat.28:13, Luk.22:45, Jhn.11:12, Act.12:6. Metaph, of death: Mat.27:52, Jhn.11:11 Act.7:60 13:36, 1Co.7:39 11:30 15:6 15:18 15:20 15:51, 1Th.4:13-15, 2Pe.3:4 (cf. Isa.14:8 43:17, 2Ma.12:45).†; SYN.: καθεύδω (AS)

G2895.definition: (a Macedonian word, = Lat. grabatus, cl. σκίμπους),  ; a camp bed, pallet: Mrk.2:4, 9 2:11-12 6:55, Jhn.5:8-11, Act.5:15 9:33 (see Swete, Mk., 24, and cf. κλίνη).†; (AS)

G2891.definition: κούμ (Tr., txt., κοῦμ, Rec. κοῦμι) (Heb. imperat. masc., used as an interjection, קוּם), ; koum (arise): Mrk.5:41.†; (AS)

G2839.definition: 1. common (general; = Lat. communis): Act.2:44 4:32; κ. πίστις, Tit.1:4; σωτηρία, Ju 3 ; 2. common (ordinary; = vulgaris); hence in LXX (1Ma.1:47, al.) and NT, unhallowed, unclean (cl., βέβηλος, which see): Mrk.7:2, 5, Act.10:14, 28 11:8, Rom.14:14, Heb.10:29, Rev.21:27.†; (AS)

G2826.definition: dimin. of κλίνη, ; a conch: Luk.5:19, 24 (cf. κλενάριον).†; (AS)

G2859.definition: 1. prop., the bosom: Jhn.13:23; fig., of close association, ἐν (εἰς τὸν) τοῖς κ. Ἀβραάμ, Luk.16:22-23 (cf. 4Ma.13:16); ὁ ὢν εἰς τὸν κ. τ. πατρός, Jhn.1:18 ; 2. The bosom or fold of a loose garment falling over a girdle, used as a pocket, hence figuratively, εἰς τὸν κ. Isa.65:6, Jer.32:18 : Luk.6:38 ; 3. A bosom-like hollow, as a bay or gulf: Act.27:39.†; (AS)

G2830.definition: (κλύζω, of the sea, to wash over),  ; a billow, surge: Luk.8:24, Jas.1:6.†; SYN.: κῦμα, a wave (AS)

G2828.definition: (κλίνω),  ; 1. a place for reclining; hence, ; (a) a hut; (b) an easy chair; (with) a couch. ; 2. a company reclining: pl., Luk.9:14 (cf. FlJ, Ant., xii, 2, 12) ; (AS)

G2845.definition: a bed: Luk.11:7; esp. the marriage-bed: κ. ἀμίαντος, Heb.13:4; κ. ἔχειν, of a woman conceiving, Rom.9:10 (cf. peculiar phrases in LXX, Lev.15:18, al.); of illicit intercourse, pl., Rom.13:13.†; (AS)

G2874.definition: a dung hill (1Ki.2:8, Psa.113:7 al.): Luk.14:35.†; κόπριον, -ου, τό,; = κόπρος, dung: pl., Luk.13:8 (WH, mg., κόφινον κοπρίων).†; (AS)

G2884.definition: (Heb. כֹּר),  ; a cor, a Hebrew measure (AV, RV, measure): Luk.16:7.†; (AS)

G2897.definition: (κρεπάλη, WH), -ης, ἡ (cf. κραιπαλάω for שִׁכּוֹר, Isa.24:20 29:9) ; drunken nausea (EV, surfeiting): Luk.21:34.†; SYN.: κῶμος, revelling; μέθη, drunkeness; οἰνοφλυγία, a debauch; πότος, a drinking bout (see Tr., Syn., § lxi). (AS)

G2866.definition: κομψός, -ή, -όν; (κομέω, to take care of), ; well-dressed, elegant, fine; compar. neut., κομψότερον ἔχειν (cf. κόμψως ἔχειν, Epict., and colloq. Eng., "to be doing finely"): Jhn.4:52.†; (AS)

G2832.definition: on the original, see Lft., Gal., 267 f.), ; Clopas: Jhn.19:25.†; (AS)

G2842.definition: (κοινωνός),  ; 1. fellowship, communion: Act.2:42, 2Co.6:14, Php.1:5; τ. υἱοῦ, 1Co.1:9; τ. αἵματος, σώματος Χρ., 1Co.10:10 : παθημάτων αὐτσῦ, Php.3:10; τ. πνεύματος, 2Co.13:13, Php.2:1; δεξιὰς κοινωνίας, Gal.2:9; τ. πίστεώς σου, Phm 6; before μετὰ: τ. πατρός, 1Jn.1:3 Jn 1:6; ἡμῶν, ἀλλήλων, 1Jn.1:3 Jn 1:7. ; 2. contribution (as outcome of fellowship): Rom.15:26, 2Co.8:4 9:13, Heb.13:6 (cf. Art. Communion, DB, i, 460…

G2849.definition: (κόλος, docked),  ; 1. to curtail, dock, prune. ; 2. to check, restrain. ; 3. to chastise, correct, punish: pass., 2Pe.2:9; mid., cause to be punished (3Ma.7:3): Act.4:21.†; (AS)

G2870.definition: (κόπτω, mid.),  ; = cl. κομμός, a beating of the head and breast, lamentation: before ἐπί with dative of person(s), Act.8:2.†; (AS)

G2804.definition: Claudius; 1. the Emperor: Act.11:28 18:2. ; 2. A military tribune, C. Lysias: Act.23:26.†; (AS)

G2846.definition: (κοίτη = Att.., δωμότιον, see Kennedy, Sources, 40),  ; a bed-chamber; ὁ ἐπὶ τοῦ κ., a chamberlain: Act.12:20.†; (AS)

G2862.definition: (Lat. colonic), ; a colony: Act.16:12 (see Lft., Phi., 50 f.).†; (AS)

G2881.definition: κορίνθιος, -α, -ον ; Corinthian; as subst., ὁ Κ., a Corinthian: Act.18:8 27:1-44 (WH, txt., R, omit), 2Co.6:11; 1Co, 2Co, tit.†; (AS)

G2834.definition: Cnidus, a city (and peninsula) on S.W. coast of Asia Minor: Act.27:7.†; (AS)

G2802.definition: Καῦδα (TR, mg., Κλαῦδα; Rec. Κλαύδή), ἡ, ; Cauda, Clauda, an island near Crete: Act.27:16.†; (AS)

G2880.definition: (κόρος, surfeit),  ; to satisfy: pass., τροφῆς, Act.27:38; metaphorically, of spiritual things, 1Co.4:8.†; (AS)

G2893.definition: (κοῦφος, light),  ; 1. intrans., to be light (poetic chiefly). ; 2. to lighten, make light: with accusative, Act.27:38.†; (AS)

G2860.definition: to dive, plunge into the sea: Act.27:43 (cf. ἐκ-κολνμβάω).†; (AS)

G2821.definition: a calling, call; in NT, always of the Divine call to salvation: Rom.11:29, 1Co.1:26 7:20, Eph.1:18 4:1, 4, Php.3:14, 2Th.1:11, 2Ti.1:9, Heb.3:1, 2Pe.1:10 (Cremer, 332).†; (AS)

G2841.definition: to have a share of, go shares in (something) with (some one), take part in: with genitive of thing(s) (as usually in cl., so Pr, l.with), Heb.2:14; with dative of thing(s), Rom.12:13 15:27, 1Ti.5:22, 1Pe.4:13, 2Jn.11; with dative of person(s), before εἰς, Php.4:15; ἐν, Gal.6:6 (cf. συν-κοινωνέω).†; (AS)

G2824.definition: (κλίνω)  ; 1. an inclination, slope, esp. the slope from the equator to the pole (Arist). ; 2. a region (Polyb., al.): pl., Rom.15:23, 2Co.11:10, Gal.1:21.†; (AS)

G2820.definition: 1. to cast lots. ; 2. to choose by lot. ; 3. to assign by lot, assign a portion: pass., ἐν ᾧ καὶ ἐκληρώθημεν, Eph.1:11 (on the various interpretations, see ICC; AR; Ellic., in l).†; (AS)
renderings: also chosen as God s own

G2831.definition: κλυδωνίζομαι; (κλύδων),  ; to be tossed by waves; metaphorically, to be tossed like waves (cf. FlJ, Ant., ix, 11, 3): Eph.4:14.†; (AS)

G2888.definition: (κόσμος, κρατέω), ; 1. in Orphic hymns, al. (see AR, Eph., l.with), a ruler of the whole world (and so in Rabbinic writings: קוֺזמוֺקְרָטוֺר). ; 2. a ruler of this world (in contrast to παντο κράτωρ): οἱ κ. τ. σκότους τούτου, the rulers of this dark world, Eph.6:12.†; (AS)

G2857.definition: (so in cl.; -ασσαί, Rec., LTr.), -ῶν, αἰ ; Colossæ, a city on the Lycus in Phrygia: Col.1:2.†; (AS)

G2850.definition: κολακία (Rec. -εία), -ας, ἡ ; (κολακεύω, to flatter), ; flattery: 1Th.2:5 (see Lft., Notes, 23).†; (AS)

G2887.definition: (κόσμος),  ; orderly, decent, modest: 1Ti.2:9 (WH, mg., -ίως, which see) 1Ti.3:2.†; (AS)

G2843.definition: (κοινωνία), ; 1. sociable. ; 2. ready to com­municate or impart (R, mg., ready to sympathize, see Field, Notes, 213 f.): 1Ti.6:18.†; (AS)

G2833.definition: (late form of κνάω), ; 1. to scratch. ; 2. to tickle; pass., to itch: 2Ti.4:3.†; (AS)

G2886.definition: (κόσμος) ; 1. pertaining to the world or universe. ; 2. of this world, earthly. Heb.9:1. ; 3. In ethical sense, worldly: ἐπιθυμίαι, Tit.2:12.†; (AS)

G2871.definition: (κόπτω),  ; 1. in cl., a stroke, a pounding (as in a mortar). ; 2. In LXX, a smiting in battle: Heb.7:1 (LXX).†; (AS)

G2811.definition: 1. a rumour, report. ; 2. good report, fame, glory: 1Pe.2:20.†; (AS)

G2854.definition: (TTr., κολλύ-, the more usual form), -ου, τό (dimin. of κολλύρα = κόλλιξ, a coarse bread roll),  ; 1. a small bread roll (LXX, ll. with). ; 2. (Usually in pl., LS, see word) an eye salve shaped like a roll: Rev.3:18.†; (AS)

G2809.definition: (κλέπτω),  ; 1. a thing stolen (Arist., LXX) ; 2. = κλοπή, theft (Plato, al.): pl., Rev.9:21.†; (AS)
